I have extensive experience improving Excel reports for finance teams, including one where I cut a weekly reporting time from 9 hours to 2 hours by restructuring the data model and applying clean formatting [ev_59e6e4b84a]. I also helped an insurance client reduce report generation from 6 hours to 1 hour while eliminating 8 recurring manual errors [ev_f58ab114ca].

My first step is to review your current spreadsheets to identify which cells need locking and how the layout can be enhanced for better readability. I will ensure that any cell protection settings are preserved when the file is converted to a Google Docs-compatible format, and I will provide a brief guide on managing these protections.

Do you have specific color schemes or branding guidelines you would like me to follow for the visual enhancements?
answers: I prefer Power BI for its advanced data modeling and visualization capabilities, but for this specific task involving Excel formatting and cell locking, I would use Microsoft Excel directly to ensure compatibility with Google Docs.

first_draft: Your urban parking app requires real-time GPS data, secure payments, and strict privacy compliance across two platforms. My background is in full-stack development for SaaS products using React, Next.js, Node, and Django, rather than native Swift or Kotlin. I will approach this by building a robust backend API in Node.js or Django to handle parking data, authentication, and Stripe/PayPal integrations, while using React Native for the cross-platform mobile interface. This ensures a single codebase for iOS and Android, reducing development time and maintenance costs. For location services, I will integrate Google Maps API to provide real-time spot availability and navigation. To meet GDPR and CCPA requirements, I will implement data minimization and secure user consent flows from day one. I will coordinate closely with your team to ensure the mobile app integrates seamlessly with your existing backend infrastructure. A concrete first step is to define the data schema for parking spots and user profiles, then prototype the map view with live data. Do you already have a backend architecture in place, or should I design the API structure as part of this engagement?
